meta.description: Set up AI Runway on AKS — from bare cluster to running model. Covers cluster verification, controller install, GPU assessment, provider setup, and first deployment. howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 带你在已有的 AKS 集群上按顺序搭好 AI Runway：检查集群是否健康，安装控制器，查看 GPU 型号，装上推理服务，然后部署首个模型。每一步都会报告状态，并在安装前征求你的同意。
howto.when: 当你说要“设置 AI Runway”“接入 AKS 集群”“安装 AI Runway”等时触发。需要先有一个 AKS 集群；如果没有，Claude 会先转去用 azure-kubernetes 技能创建集群。

howto.what_en: Guides you through setting up AI Runway on an existing AKS cluster: verify the cluster, install the controller, assess GPUs, install an inference provider, and deploy a first model. Reports status at each step and asks before installing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to set up AI Runway, onboard an AKS cluster, or install AI Runway. Requires an existing AKS cluster; otherwise hands off to the azure-kubernetes skill first.
